page.overview:
Who is Forest inhabitant?

The Forest Inhabitants appear in the episode "Storytelling." This is a list of the Forest Inhabitants that appear exclusively at the Rite of Forest Justice or just prior when attacking Finn. The other more notable animals are listed in inhabitants of the forest.

Bats are some of the animals only at the Rite of Forest Justice. It looks like a normal bat.

Beavers are one of the animals present only at the Rite of Forest Justice. They look like normal beavers.

A cat is one of the animals present only at the Rite of Forest Justice. It is a fluffy gray cat with a red nose.
